headline: What Does Hormel Foods (HRL) Pork Price Fixing Lawsuit Mean For Investors?
summary: Hormel Foods (NYSE: HRL) has been named as a defendant in a major antitrust class action lawsuit alleging price fixing in the U.S. pork industry. The case claims a conspiracy among several pork producers to coordinate and inflate prices for pork products sold across the country. Some co-defendants have reached settlements, while legal proceedings involving Hormel Foods and others are continuing in court.
